## Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Component Affected
- [ ] Database (schema, constraints, triggers, procedures, views)
- [ ] Backend API (Flask routes, mysql connector, authentication)
- [ ] Frontend UI (React pages, components, CSS)
- [ ] Documentation / Setup

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error (or SQL error code)

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior / Error Message
If applicable, paste the exact error message or SQLSTATE code (e.g., `ERROR 1644 (45000)`).

## Environment
- OS: [e.g., Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS]
- MySQL Version: [e.g., 8.0.36]
- Python Version: [e.g., 3.11]
- Node.js Version: [e.g., 20.10]
- Browser: [e.g., Chrome, Firefox]
